Trap: the root has only an AGENTS.md, and packages/api/CLAUDE.md imports both AGENTS.md files, the root's as `@../../AGENTS.md`. Launched headless (claude -p, the Agent SDK, CI) in packages/api, that CLAUDE.md switches AGENTS.md off, and its import of the root AGENTS.md resolves outside the launch directory: an external import, which loads only after an approval recorded in ~/.claude.json. Nothing records one, so the root AGENTS.md never arrives (rule claude.imports). It is imported, not merely switched off, so it is neither claude.agents-shadowed nor a reason for claude.words-not-import; map used to list it twice and report both.
